content:
Hi everyone! Next spring I'm teaching a Lean seminar at Duke and want undergraduates to formalize Section 2 of GNNW ("Optimizing the CGMS upper bound"), depending on @Bhavik Mehta's ExponentialRamsey.

Has anyone already started a GNNW formalization? Couldn't find one on GitHub.

Thanks!

None that I know of! But please do keep me updated with how this goes, and let me know if I can help with anything! I expect the meat of the work in this paper will be quite a bit nicer than the version I did (perhaps I should've been more patient :) )

Thanks Bhavik! Will definitely keep you posted as the seminar gets going. I'm still planning the course, and I'll likely have some questions about the ExponentialRamsey API later on. Really appreciate the offer to help!
